subject: Application for the Detection Engineering Internship
paragraphs: I am a final-year MSc Cybersecurity student and would like to apply for the six-month detection engineering internship starting in March 2027.
During my apprenticeship at Acme Security I triage about forty alerts a day in Splunk Enterprise Security and wrote Python enrichment scripts that cut manual triage time by a third.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my detection-as-code project could support your team.
